title: Flow arrival and filter evaluation: websocket to view update
answers: What happens when a new flow arrives in mitmweb?
How is the flow list view order updated?
body:
Filters are evaluated by the BACKEND, not the frontend.
- `ducks/ui/filter.ts` (setFilter/setHighlight) only stores strings. `backends/websocket.tsx:WebSocketBackend.onStoreUpdate` sends `flows/updateFilter {name, expr}` on change.
- `mitmproxy/tools/web/app.py:ClientConnection.update_filter` stores parsed filter in `self.filters[name]`, replies `flows/filterUpdate` with `matching_flow_ids` (null if cleared). `_broadcast_flow` evaluates all filters per flow and sends `matching_filters`.
- `WebSocketBackend.onMessage` maps flows/add|update|filterUpdate|remove to actions via `queueOrDispatch` (buffers in `activeFetches` during initial `fetchData` GET; `receive` dispatches FLOWS_RECEIVE then replays), so reducer tolerates duplicate add/unknown ids.
- FLOWS_ADD: append to list/_listIndex/byId; if `matching_filters[Search]` is true/undefined -> `insertViewItem` with `makeSort(sort)` (findInsertPos: append fast path else binary search, rewrites _viewIndex after pos); Highlight true -> add to highlightedIds.
- FLOWS_UPDATE: compare old (`_viewIndex.get`) vs new membership -> insertViewItem / removeViewItemAt / updateViewItem (bubbles to sorted position).
- FLOWS_FILTER_UPDATE Search rebuilds view (toSorted+buildIndex); `setSort` re-sorts view.
